oṃ namaḥ śivāyaḥ || tato saṃdhyā(?) || nośiya(?) || oṃ hrāṁ ātmatatvāye svāhā || oṃ hrīṁ vidyātatvāye svāhā || oṃ hrūṁ śivatatvāye svāhā || aiṁ nāśāṃputadvaye (2) karṇadvaye (2) hṛdaya śira śikhā || oṃ uparasparasanaṃ (3) || hnasahnāsathīya || nyāsa || namaste rudrarūpe hraḥ mahā

astrāye phaṭ || oṃ hrāṁ aghore hrāṁ sarvvajñātā hṛdayāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ thaghore hrīṁ brahma śirase svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ ghoraghoranta hūṁ jvālinī śikhāyai vauṣaṭ || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvata sarvva sarvve hrai kavacāya hūṁ || oṃ hrāṃ juṃ saḥ jyotirūpātmane hrauṁ netratrayāya vaṣaṭ || oṃ hrāṁ namaste rudrarūpe hraḥ
mahāpāśupatāya astrāye phaṭ || iti karāṅganyāsa ||
oṃ hrāṁ kṣaṁ īśānāya ūrddhavaktrāye namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ yaṁ tatpuruṣāye pūrvvavaktrāye namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ raṁ aghorāya dakṣiṇavaktrāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ vaṁ vāmadevāye uttaravaktrāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ laṃ sadyojātāye paścimavaktrāye namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ
kṣaṁ īśānāya varāmparavaktrāye namaḥ iti vaktraṃ nyāsa || tāhāraposalaṃkhatāne || oṃ gaṃgāye namaḥ || oṃ yamunāye namaḥ || oṃ nirmmadāye namaḥ || oṃ kāveryai namaḥ || oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ || oṃ gaṃḍakyai namaḥ || oṃ kauśikyai namaḥ || oṃ goḍāvarī namaḥ || jāpa ||
oṃ japaṃ gṛhānaṃ svāhā || śirasa laṃkhataṃne || oṃ hrāṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || oṃ hrīṁ śirase svāhā || oṃ hrūṁ śikhāye vauṣaṭ || oṃ hreṁ kavacāye hūṁ || oṃ hrūṁ netrayāya vauṣaṭ || prāṇāyāma || oṃ hrāṁ rudra ṛṣi agnidevatā gāyatrī svacchanda prāṇāyāma viniyogaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ vāmanāśāṃpute ||
oṃ hrīṁ dakṣiṇanāśāṃpute || oṃ hrāṁ devasvarūpaṃ dhyātvā || yaṁ (10) raṁ (10) vaṁ (10) || tato dhyāna || nośiya || oṃ hrāṁ ātmatatvāyetyādi || nyāsa || oṃ hrīṁ raktabhūṣāvarāraktrājatā jajñopavītanī | haṃsapadmāsanā bālā
caturvvaktrā catubhujā || śruvākṣamālinī dakṣa vāme daṇḍakamaṇḍaluṃ | brāhmaṇasya trisaṃdhyāyāṃ prātaṣṭhārā kṛte vare ||
tato gāyatrī || oṃ hrāṁ tatmaheśāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahe tanno raudra pracodayāt || jāpa (10) || oṃ sarvvapāpakṣayaṃ
kāmanārthaṃ idaṃ japaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ ādityasya śivaṃ vidyā śivamādityarūpinaṃ || ubhayārantaraṃ nāsti ādityasya śivasya ca || iti madhyānasaṃdhyā || nośiye || nyāsa || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo devabhyaḥ svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo mantrebhya
svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo ṛṣibhya svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo manubhya svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo manuṣyabhya svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo pitṛbhya svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo mātṛbhyo svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo bhūtabhya svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo piśācebhya
svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvebhyo iṣṭadevatebhya svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ saḥ sūryyāye namaḥ || oṃ haṃ ṣaṃ ṣorakasūryyamūrttaye namaḥ || oṃ prakāsakastisahitāye namaḥ || oṃ hrīṁ ccha namo nārāyanāye viśvatmane namaḥ || oṃ hrīṁ lakṣmīśaktisahitāye
namaḥ || oṃ hrīṁ aghore hrīṁ thaghore hrīṁ ghoraghorantare hūṁ phre sarvvataḥ sarvva sarvve hre ju saḥ hrau rūdrarūpe hraḥ (*) svacchandabhai mahābhairavāya sadāśivāye namaḥ || oṃ hrīṁ aghoreśvarī śaktisahitāya namaḥ || oṃ juṁ saḥ mṛtyuñjayāye
amṛtīsaśvaramahābhairavāye netrabhattārikāye sadāśivāye namaḥ || oṃ juṁ saḥ amṛtalakṣmī saktisahitāye namaḥ || nyāsayāya || oṃ hrāṁ hṛadyāya ātmane namaḥ || hraḥ astrāye phaṭ || iti saṃdhyāvidhisamāptaḥ ||
tato liṃgārccanavidhi liṣyate || gurunamaskāra || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ jena carācaraṃ || tatpadaṃ daśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve nama || gurubrahmā guruviṣṇu gurudevo maheśvaraṃ | gurudeva jagatsarvva tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ ||

puṣpaṃ namaḥ || āmāsanāya namaḥ || ātmamūttaya namaḥ || oṃ karkkāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ saḥ sūryyaye namaḥ || (**?) ñjali || (3) oṃ heṣaṣoraka sūryamūrttaye namaḥ || oṃ prakāśaktisahitāya namaḥ || oṃ sahasrakiranāya vidmahe
kṛntāya dhīmahe tanno sūryya pracodayāt ḥ || āvāhanā sthāpana caṃdanākṣata puṣpaṃ namaḥ || jāpa || oṃ hrāṁ svāhā (10) || nyāsa || oṃ chaṁ namo nārāyaṇāya astrāye phaṭ || chaṁ namo nārāyaṇāya hṛdayāya namaḥ || chaṁ namo

āvāhanādi jāpa || hrāṃ svāhā (10) ||
nyāsa || oṃ juṁ saḥ anantaśaktaye astrāye phaṭ ḥ || karasodhanaṃ || oṃ juṁ saḥ sarvvajñātā hṛdayāye namaḥ || oṃ juṁ saḥ vyomatipti śirase svāhāḥ || oṃ juṁ saḥ anādibodha śikhāye vauṣaṭ ḥ ||
oṃ juṁ saḥ hūṁ svamantra kavacāye hūṁ || oṃ ju saḥ aluptaśaktaye netratrayāya vauṣaṭ ḥ || oṃ ju saḥ anantaśaktaye astrāye phaṭ ḥ || oṃ ju saḥ vṛṣāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ ju saḥ mṛtyuṃjayāya amṛtīśamahābhairavāye
